validation.note: the reference fee over the list price proxies how hard a lane is for drivers; a positive rho means the dealer accepts dearer quotes where drivers cost more, i.e. the competitor is dearer there. Weak rho at lane level is expected: the per-lane sample is thin, so trust the place-level aggregates more.
